Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-AWQ.description: 14B parameter model quantized to INT4 AWQ. Weights ~8.5 GB. Ideal for 2x 8GB cluster (PP=2, zero offload, ~4.25 GB per GPU) or single 12GB GPU.
Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-AWQ.recommended_hardware: Cluster 2x 8GB (PP=2, 100% in VRAM) oppure Singola GPU 12GB

Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ.description: 7B parameter model quantized to INT4 AWQ. Weights ~4.5 GB. Perfect single-GPU testing benchmark for 8GB VRAM (RTX 4070 Laptop).
